card.text: A Cepheid in the Large Magellanic Cloud that swells and shrinks every 8.7 days.

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 47.8 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 39,621 parsecs away.

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
